title: reader MAX_AUTH_FAILURES name misleads about scope (per-session, not per-user)
description: reader/session/context.rs: MAX_AUTH_FAILURES sounds like a global account lockout but it is a per-session limit. Rename to MAX_AUTH_FAILURES_PER_SESSION or add a doc comment clarifying it limits consecutive AUTHINFO PASS failures within one TCP session, not across sessions or users.
